svg.text: C64 BASIC V2 RND — aggregate atlas of the entire functional graph
2,936,012,800 canonical states • 15 components • depth bins of 500
Each column is one complete component; brightness is log-scaled within that column
How to read it: a bright cell means many starts in that component have that depth.
Column brightness is normalized separately so tiny components are visible; percentages above columns preserve absolute scale.
This preserves exact component/depth counts but intentionally does not draw 2.94 billion individual nodes or edges.
